links.comparator_used: Individual LLMs grounded in single evidence sources (PubMed, general online content, or the Atropos Alexandria library); no formal single-LLM accuracy comparison is reported in the abstract
links.outcome: Share of physician-submitted biomedical questions answered reliably, and agreement across LLMs
links.effect: Two or more LLMs agreed on an answer 49% of the time; the ensemble combined with the Alexandria custom source gave reliable answers to over 64% of biomedical queries. General-purpose LLMs grounded in public information varied greatly in their answers, even when sourced from the same publication.
links.quote: Using an ensemble approach, we observed that 49% of the time, two or more LLMs agreed on an answer.

design_hint: retrieval grounding and multi-LLM ensemble agreement
